audience: dispatchers and field-service teams that plan vehicle routes with Routific

useCases.title: Plan the routes of one fleet for a day
useCases.text: Optimize the routes for a fleet with time windows and capacity. Use it for up to about 60 visits; use a background job above that.

useCases.title: Plan a large route problem as a background job
useCases.text: Submit a route problem of up to 2500 visits as a background job. Read the job until it is finished to get the route plan.

useCases.title: Plan same-day pickups and deliveries
useCases.text: Plan routes where each order is picked up before it is dropped off by the same driver. Use a background job above 30 orders.
